name: anamnesis
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code — deterministic capture via lifecycle hooks. Per-user encrypted, visible, deletable. 0.3.2 makes the Stop hook non-blocking and incremental: capture runs in a detached background worker and ships only the transcript lines added since the last turn (per-transcript high-water mark + lock), instead of re-sending the whole transcript and every historical usage row on every Stop. Also fixes ARG_MAX-related silent failures on large payloads (curl/jq bodies now go over stdin) and garbage-collects unreplayable queue files. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + DCR via 'anamnesis-config'; legacy X-Anamnesis-Key fallback kept through the 2026-05-20 deprecation cutoff.
